display_title: [Dirty Talk Anthology] Urology Department in Front of Obstetrics and Gynecology Department
description:
*“Should I stop? There’s already a mess inside you.”*

Won-Young, who suspected frigidity, goes to see his friend Yeon-Woo for treatment.

 *“No! That’s not it. It hurts. It really hurts.”
“Yeah.”
“Don’t take it out. Keep going.”*

The thrilling sensation that comes every time the black nitrile gloves pass between her legs. Won-Young can’t hold back a moan at the leaking love juice. 

*“Right now, I think I’m going to go. So do something about it.”*

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Note: Part of RIDI's Deotitong Danpyeonseon (더티톡 단편선) Collection.*
